correctness.rationale: For every finite nonempty outward immediate-child forest, equal-colored leaves satisfy identical Boolean/modal formulas, so their separation is necessary. Under leaf injection, a height-exact formula and the uniquely colored leaf at precisely that distance isolate each vertex because a leaf has a unique ancestor at a fixed distance; the formula depth is at most global height. Thus the algebra is full exactly under leaf injection. Exact coloring count is \((2^k)_{\underline L}(2^k)^{n-L}\), yielding rank \(\lceil\log_2 L\rceil\). A monochrome directed path of height \(h\) gives sharpness. Birthday asymptotics follow by logarithmic expansion and collision bounds. Independent finite signature and Boolean-closure checks passed 830839 labelings, 4435 closures, and 30 sharp paths; unrestricted proof is analytic, not inferred from testing.

originality.rationale: Actual comparisons of prior hypotheses and implications distinguish the new full leaf-injection criterion and all-valuation census for arbitrary outward immediate-child forests from (i) Carr’s general modal-colouring equivalence, (ii) Agnew’s transitive K4 local-finiteness theorem, (iii) the total functional-successor generator census, (iv) atom-free type-complete tree sizes and graded/plain quotient comparisons, and (v) generic modal inequivalence certificate algorithms. Published-result and primary-literature comparisons did not yield the claim, but negative search alone is not treated as priority proof. An earlier forest-specific lemma in other terminology remains an explicitly stated risk.
residual_risks: A preexisting specialized theorem on observable labeled rooted trees, perhaps expressed through automata or coalgebraic terminology, might state the leaf-only criterion; the search was bounded and priority remains provisional.
The general modal colouring theorem is a substantive antecedent, although converting it into this leaf-only test and exact census requires an additional forest-specific argument.
The full proof of the generic 2022 modal-witness algorithm was not closely inspected beyond its abstract, so no whole-document negative novelty judgment is made for that source.

value.rationale: The family-wide generator rank and exact tuple census classify an infinite natural class of finite modal complex algebras, not a fixed-parameter table or textbook fact about a single frame. The independence from all internal vertex colors and from forest shape after \(n,L\) is a structural rigidity principle; a sharp modal depth bound and complete random-generation threshold quantify its operational consequences. A shared-descendant counterexample marks a natural and necessary boundary. These conclusions provide direct tests for any finite forest, unlike generic decidability alone.
